name: Warm Asparagus Salad with Roasted Peppers, Black Beans & Almonds
instructions: Drain and rinse the beans in a colander; set aside to drain further.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.

Cut peppers into large pieces and toss in a large bowl with oil, oregano, salt, and pepper. Spread in a single layer on a parchment-lined baking sheet and roast in the oven, until beginning to soften, 10 minutes. Save bowl for use in the next step.
Snap or cut off the woody ends of the asparagus. Place in the large bowl with additional oil and oregano.
Halve and pit the avocado. Slice into chunks while still in the skin, then scoop out into a blender. Juice lime into the blender.
Peel and mince garlic; add to the blender along with oil and purée until smooth, 30-60 seconds. Add water to thin out the dressing if necessary.
Add asparagus to the oven with peppers and roast until tender, about 10 minutes.
Peel and thinly slice the shallots into rings.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons.
To serve, divide roasted peppers and asparagus between plates and top with beans, shallots, basil, and almonds; drizzle with dressing and enjoy!
author: Mealime
